name: unifi
description: UniFi fleet, Network and Protect tools: Site Manager view of every console, per-console control via the cloud Connector or a local console. Read-only unless writes are enabled.

sm_api_key.title: Site Manager API key
sm_api_key.description: From unifi.ui.com > API. An organization key reaches every console in the organization; a personal key only reaches consoles you own.

allow_writes.title: Allow changes
allow_writes.description: Expose write tools (restart devices, PoE cycle, guest access, vouchers, non-GET API calls). Every write still needs confirm=true.

local_url.title: Local console URL (optional)
local_url.description: Console reached directly on the LAN, e.g. https://192.168.1.1. Available as console='home'. Leave blank for cloud only.

local_api_key.title: Local console API key (optional)
local_api_key.description: UniFi Network > Settings > Control Plane > Integrations on that console.

default_console.title: Default console (optional)
default_console.description: Console used when a tool call omits console=, e.g. home or a console hostname.
